title: The Elephant and his Master & Habitual Actions
subject: English Language
objectives: Read and understand a story about power and consequences

blocks.alt: A man standing next to a large elephant
blocks.caption: Hamsaki and the elephants.

blocks.md:
In a far village of Sambesi, there lived a family of twenty elephants and their master called Hamsaki. Hamsaki had a wife and five children who made the elephants do all kinds of work on the farm, and for other villagers who wanted some fast jobs to be done.

One day, the mother elephant told her young ones, 'The human beings we work for, are much smaller than us in size. Why should we be serving them? From today, any human being who comes here will be made to serve us.'

'How can you do that?' one young elephant asked their mother.

'Never mind,' she said. 'I will put my weight on the first person who comes here and then I will force others to do what I demand or I will crush that person with just one stamping.'

'I see,' said the young elephant. 'I did not know that we have such huge power to make Hamsaki serve us.'

On that morning it was Hamsaki who came there first. The mother elephant placed him on the floor and put his left foot on his chest while waiting for the other members of the family to come out. But Hamsaki died due to the heavy weight of the elephant's foot.

On seeing this, the members of Hamsaki's family got frightened and they ran away to another village. The elephants did not have anyone to feed them any more. And as from that day onwards, elephants became wild animals.

Habitual actions are things we do **every day**.

- Teacher: *I come to school every day.*
- Jibril: *I water the plants every day.*
- Ngozi: *I visit my grandmother every day.*
- Kunle: *They play football every day after school.*
- Ayo: *My father goes to his office every morning.*

quiz.q: How many elephants were in the family?
quiz.explain: There were twenty elephants in the family.

quiz.q: What did the mother elephant want the humans to do?
quiz.explain: She wanted any human who came there to serve the elephants.

options: He died from the elephant's weight
quiz.explain: He died due to the heavy weight of the elephant's foot.
